note: Publicly reported Counter-Strike buyout fees (insider and press estimates, none confirmed by the clubs), used only to set the dollar scale of the transfer values (scripts/cs2_value.py). A '+'-joined nick is a group deal, priced as the sum of its players. The transfer date is the players' first map for the buying team in the bo3.gg stats; moves before Jul 2024 (under six months of stats) are not used.
